connector.name: MCP Adr Analysis Server
connector.registryDescription: AI-powered MCP server for analyzing Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-adr-analysis-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tosin2013 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROJECT_PATH
env.description: Path to the project directory to analyze (defaults to current directory)

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key for AI-powered analysis (required for full execution mode)

env.name: EXECUTION_MODE
env.description: Execution mode: 'full' for AI results or 'prompt-only' for prompts (default: prompt-only)

env.name: ADR_DIRECTORY
env.description: ADR directory relative to project path (default: docs/adrs)
